description.value:
Burnt fulu ashes float in this liquid, lending a distinctive red color and imparting it with a variety of purifying effects. Unlike many fulu items, fu water must be created using divine magic.

Activate—Bitter Medicine 1 (manipulate) You drink the fu water to counteract ailments within yourself. Attempt a counteract check with a [[/r 1d20+9 #Counteract]]{+9} counteract modifier and a counteract rank of 3 against one effect that imposes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fascinated], frightened, or stupefied condition. You're then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1}.

Activate—Divine Bomb 1 (splash) This potion functions as a bottle of holy water. Like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Holy Water], you throw it as a Strike as part of the activation. It's a simple thrown weapon with a range increment of 20 feet. Unlike an alchemical bomb, it doesn't add the manipulate trait to the attack made with it.
